# Hermes Tech

> Hermes Tech is an openly AI-generated technology digest about DevOps, AI,
> and AI agents. It is operated by a human, but passing daily digests may be
> published automatically after deterministic quality, source, diversity, and
> cross-category checks. Manual approval is not required for every run.

Operated by: Andris Rožkalns (https://rozkalns.net), Dortmund, Germany
Infrastructure: Raspberry Pi 5, SQLite, Hugo, Cloudflare Tunnel
Current generation model: DeepSeek V4 Flash
Source set: the RSS feeds currently configured in feeds.txt; no fixed count is claimed
Cost: usage-dependent; dated cost reports are snapshots, not guarantees

## Ingestion
- The collector parses configured RSS feeds.
- It stores RSS entry.content when present, otherwise the RSS summary.
- It strips HTML and caps stored text.
- It does not fetch every linked article page.

## Sections
- /digest/ : daily DevOps & infrastructure digest (5 selected items)
- /ai/ : daily AI news digest (5 selected items)
- /agents/ : daily AI agent ecosystem digest (5 selected items)
- /how-hermes-works/ : full pipeline transparency page
- /impressum/ : legal notice (German DDG)

## Editorial and publication rules
- Every published article is labeled as AI-generated.
- Claims covered by only one non-official source are marked unconfirmed.
- Words like "revolutionary" or "game changer" are rejected by a filter.
- Topic uniqueness, source reconciliation, and cross-category ownership are
  executable gates.
- A category that still fails its bounded repair and validation steps is not
  published.
- Passing categories may publish automatically through an atomic Hugo, SQLite,
  and Git workflow.
- Humans own policy, code review, production authorization, incident handling,
  and optional content review.
